nodes.description: Maximum NFT supply constant (8888) used as the cap in mintNFT and as the total supply for RandomlyAssigned.
Public sale price per NFT (0.18 ether) checked against msg.value in mintNFT; settable by owner.
Presale price per NFT (0.09 ether) checked against msg.value in mintNFT; settable by owner.
Maximum NFTs mintable per wallet during the final/public sale phase.
Maximum NFTs mintable per wallet during the presale phase.
Boolean gate that must be true for mintNFT to proceed; toggled by flipSaleState.
Timestamp controlling when the final sale begins; writable by owner via setPublicSaleStartTimestamp.
Mapping of addresses allowed on the presale whitelist, managed by addToWhitelist/removeFromWhitelist.
Base URI returned by _baseURI() and used to compose tokenURI; set by setBaseURI.
External payable mint entry point. Checks sale state, supply cap, phase-dependent price and per-wallet cap, then loops nextToken()/_safeMint(msg.sender, tokenId).
Owner-only fund distribution that splits the contract balance across four hardcoded addresses using low-level call{value:}.
Owner-only reserved mint that loops nextToken() and _safeMint(msg.sender, tokenId).
RandomlyAssigned.nextToken: derives a pseudo-random index from msg.sender, block.coinbase, block.difficulty, block.gaslimit and block.timestamp (weak randomness, timestamp dependency).
View returning true when block.timestamp >= publicSaleStartTimestamp; drives the phase branch in mintNFT.
Owner-only toggle of saleIsActive.
Owner-only loop adding addresses to the whitelisted mapping.
Owner-only loop removing addresses from the whitelisted mapping.
Owner-only setter for baseTokenURI; emits BaseURIChanged.
Owner-only setter for publicSaleStartTimestamp.
Owner-only setter for NFT_PRICE.
Owner-only setter for NFT_PRICE_PRESALE.
Owner-only setter for MAX_NFT_WALLET.
Owner-only setter for MAX_NFT_WALLET_PRESALE.
Public view returning the whitelist status of an address.
Hook overridden to chain ERC721 and ERC721Enumerable bookkeeping before transfers/mints/burns.
ERC165 interface support resolver overriding ERC721/ERC721Enumerable.
Internal view returning baseTokenURI for tokenURI composition.
Caller-controlled address used for minting recipient, balance checks and weak randomness seeding.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for sale-phase determination and as a randomness seed.
Transaction origin; not referenced in this code but tracked as a potential untrusted source.
Four sequential low-level call{value:} transfers to hardcoded addresses before any state is finalized; external-call surface with reentrancy potential.
Pseudo-random index derived from block variables including block.timestamp, predictable/manipulable by miners or callers.
_safeMint triggers IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received on the recipient contract, giving control to an untrusted address mid-mint.
Caller-supplied quantity of NFTs to mint in mintNFT.
Owner-supplied quantity of reserved NFTs to mint in reserveNFT.
Array of addresses to whitelist.
Array of addresses to remove from the whitelist.
Address whose whitelist status is queried.
New base URI string assigned to baseTokenURI.
New sale start timestamp assigned to publicSaleStartTimestamp.
Loop-local token id produced by nextToken and passed to _safeMint.
Cached contract balance used to compute the payout shares.
25% share of the balance sent to the first hardcoded address.
5% share of the balance sent to the second hardcoded address.
35% share of the balance sent to the third hardcoded address.
35% share of the balance sent to the fourth hardcoded address.
Pseudo-random index computed from block variables and msg.sender.

edges.reason: msg.sender supplies the recipient used in the mint loop and per-wallet cap checks in mintNFT.
msg.sender is packed into the pseudo-random seed inside nextToken, making the outcome caller-influenceable.
reserveNFT mints the generated token to msg.sender via _safeMint.
block.timestamp is compared against publicSaleStartTimestamp in hasFinalSaleStarted (timestamp dependency).
publicSaleStartTimestamp is the owner-controlled boundary used for phase determination.
hasFinalSaleStarted gates whether the final-sale or presale price and wallet cap branch of mintNFT executes.
saleIsActive must be true for mintNFT to proceed.
MAX_NFT_SUPPLY bounds tokenCount() + amountOfNFTs in mintNFT.
NFT_PRICE is multiplied by amountOfNFTs and compared with msg.value in the final-sale branch.
NFT_PRICE_PRESALE is multiplied by amountOfNFTs and compared with msg.value in the presale branch.
MAX_NFT_WALLET caps balanceOf(msg.sender) + amountOfNFTs in the final-sale branch.
MAX_NFT_WALLET_PRESALE caps balanceOf(msg.sender) + amountOfNFTs in the presale branch.
mintNFT calls nextToken() inside its mint loop to derive each token id.
nextToken feeds block-derived values into an unsafe randomness computation.
block.timestamp is a seed component of the pseudo-random index in nextToken (timestamp dependency).
mintNFT invokes _safeMint which performs onERC721Received on the recipient, handing control to an untrusted contract mid-loop.
reserveNFT calls nextToken() for each reserved token.
reserveNFT invokes _safeMint, triggering the receiver callback on an untrusted recipient.
withdrawAll transfers ETH with low-level call{value:}, an external callback surface.
The low-level value transfers can re-enter withdrawAll before the final balance accounting completes.
amountOfNFTs parameter drives the price, cap and loop computations of mintNFT.
amountOfNFTs parameter controls the iteration count of reserveNFT.
addresses array is iterated and written into the whitelisted mapping by addToWhitelist.
addresses array is iterated and cleared from the whitelisted mapping by removeFromWhitelist.
addr parameter is used as the lookup key in checkIfWhitelisted.
baseURI parameter is stored into baseTokenURI by setBaseURI.
_amount parameter is stored into publicSaleStartTimestamp by setPublicSaleStartTimestamp.
tokenId local holds the nextToken result and is passed to _safeMint inside mintNFT.
balance local holds address(this).balance used for the payout share arithmetic.
AhmedBal is the value forwarded to the first hardcoded address via low-level call.
Addr1 is the value forwarded to the second hardcoded address via low-level call.
Addr2 is the value forwarded to the third hardcoded address via low-level call.
Addr3 is the value forwarded to the fourth hardcoded address via low-level call.
random local holds the weakly random index used for the tokenMatrix swap logic in nextToken.
addToWhitelist writes true into the whitelisted mapping.
removeFromWhitelist writes false into the whitelisted mapping.
checkIfWhitelisted reads the whitelisted mapping.
addToWhitelist mutates the whitelisted state variable.
removeFromWhitelist mutates the whitelisted state variable.
_baseURI returns the baseTokenURI state variable.
setBaseURI writes the baseTokenURI state variable.
setBaseURI reads and overwrites baseTokenURI.
setPublicSaleStartTimestamp writes publicSaleStartTimestamp.
setPublicSaleStartTimestamp reads and overwrites publicSaleStartTimestamp.
setNFT_PRICE writes NFT_PRICE.
setNFT_PRICE_PRESALE writes NFT_PRICE_PRESALE.
setMAX_NFT_WALLET writes MAX_NFT_WALLET.
setMAX_NFT_WALLET_PRESALE writes MAX_NFT_WALLET_PRESALE.
flipSaleState negates saleIsActive.
mintNFT indirectly triggers the _beforeTokenTransfer hook through _safeMint.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter only exists to bound the mint loop and price/cap math inside mintNFT, so it collapses into that function node.
The parameter only controls the reserved mint loop inside reserveNFT, so it collapses into that function node.
The array parameter is consumed solely by the whitelisting loop, so it collapses into addToWhitelist.
The array parameter is consumed solely by the un-whitelisting loop, so it collapses into removeFromWhitelist.
The address parameter is only a lookup key for the view function, so it collapses into checkIfWhitelisted.
The string parameter is only assigned to baseTokenURI, so it collapses into setBaseURI.
The parameter is only assigned to publicSaleStartTimestamp, so it collapses into that setter.
tokenId is a loop temporary holding the nextToken result before _safeMint, so it merges into the nextToken operation.
balance is a transient read of address(this).balance used only for the payout split, so it collapses into withdrawAll.
AhmedBal is immediately forwarded by the first low-level value transfer, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
Addr1 is immediately forwarded by the second low-level value transfer, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
Addr2 is immediately forwarded by the third low-level value transfer, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
Addr3 is immediately forwarded by the fourth low-level value transfer, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
random is the direct product of the weak seed computation and drives the tokenMatrix mapping, so it merges into the randomness unsafe operation.
